body.subject: Mobile: my branch is a Rust/crate slice, uncompiled — can you run the checks, and take the frontend?
body.body:
My work is uncommitted in /Users/xiyuanpan/Pastey-exp-claude (branch exp/mobile-claude); read docs/research/mobile-support.md first. I could not run cargo, npm or xcodebuild in my session, so none of it is built or tested.

Request 1: if you can run commands, please run these in that worktree and tell me exactly what fails.
- cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
- cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin pastey

Then `cargo check --lib --target aarch64-apple-ios` and `--target aarch64-linux-android` if the targets are installed.

Request 2: split of work. Please do not redo the lib.rs/main.rs split, or you and I will conflict on main.rs. I keep the Rust crate and the capabilities, plus the milestone doc. You take the frontend mobile pass: the screens hidden on a phone (Bridge details Workspaces and Full Access, Developer Mode, the Agents tab's "This device" section), the Full Access consent warning for a phone, and the app-resume reconnect (visibilitychange). If you already started on other files, tell me which and I will stay clear.

body.subject: Mobile: two decisions, and a way to get the checks run
body.body:
1. Which phone first? My default is iOS first, because your net-probe notes use an iPhone hotspot, with Android straight after. About 90% of M1–M3 is shared. If you have no iPhone to test on, say so and I will put Android first.
2. The Tauri mobile shell needs the app as a library crate. That changes every documented test command from `cargo test --bin pastey` to `cargo test --lib`, and makes a desktop release build link the library three times. I already made the change on exp/mobile-claude and updated the docs. Do you accept the split? There is no alternative that keeps the binary-only crate.

Neither I nor, as far as I know, codex can run cargo, npm or Xcode in these sessions. Could you run `cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin pastey` and `npm run build` in /Users/xiyuanpan/Pastey-exp-claude and paste me any errors? Everything on the branch is unverified until then.

summary.done: Investigated the repo and wrote docs/research/mobile-support.md (scope, findings, design, milestones M0-M4 with acceptance tests, open decisions). Wrote the M0 slice on exp/mobile-claude (uncommitted, uncompiled): lib.rs/main.rs split with cfg(desktop) gating, Cargo and capability changes for mobile, write_temp_file_raw and get_local_network_addresses commands, platform and phone file-picker helpers, safe-area and touch CSS, address-based pairing UI, hidden desktop-only items, two tests, and doc updates from --bin pastey to --lib.
summary.decisions: A phone is a Bridge peer without Agent capabilities that works while the app is open and reaches Agents on desktops as an ordinary requester; no new authority path, and approving a Review from a phone is out of scope. A phone is always the joiner and pairs by address plus code, because iOS broadcast probably needs Apple's multicast entitlement. Phone-to-desktop files go as raw bytes up to 64 MB for now.
summary.open: Nothing is compiled or run; the crate may not yet compile for iOS or Android. Needs the user's answers on phone priority and on accepting the library split. Platform facts (iOS multicast entitlement, iroh fast-apple-datapath, suspended sockets, file picker return values) are marked "to verify".
summary.next: Once codex or the user reports compile results, fix what breaks. Then M1: gate the Agent adapters and Developer Terminal host side on mobile, run tauri ios init and tauri android init, and get the app to start in a simulator and an emulator.
